title: Self-Attention & Multiple Heads — Do Not Read the Future
key_insight: A causal mask removes future positions before softmax. A padding mask separately removes empty batch positions. Combining them requires matching signs, types, and dimensions.
body:
## Do Not Read the Future

A language model predicting token five must not use token six from the training answer. Parallel computation would otherwise leak it.

A causal mask removes future positions before softmax. A padding mask separately removes empty batch positions. Combining them requires matching signs, types, and dimensions.

Inspect a tiny attention matrix by hand. One incorrect mask can produce excellent training loss and useless real generation.
common_mistakes: Every attention head is manually programmed with a grammar rule.
Self-attention compares a sequence only with an unrelated database.
Causal language models should train by looking at future answers.
mini_exercise: Draw “Do Not Read the Future” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: This is the working mechanism that turns attention intuition into transformer representations.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Do Not Read the Future,” explain Self-Attention & Multiple Heads without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
